enforced_by: zod/page.schema.ts: Block.unit_id is z.string().nullable(), not optional
zod/content-item.schema.ts: ReadingStatus.text and .english are nullable, not optional
zod/site-issue.schema.ts: IssueMention.printed_name is nullable, not optional
zod/media.schema.ts: MediaDepicted.person_id is nullable, not optional
pydantic/page.py, pydantic/content_item.py, pydantic/site_issue.py, pydantic/media.py: the same fields typed X | None with no default
pruzhany-steps: the bundled Zod validator (schemas/site-next/validate-archive.js), before site_writer installs a document
known_looser.export_says: The key must be there, and its value may be null: the key is in required and its schema is anyOf with a null branch.
known_looser.linkml_says: LinkML has no null apart from absence. A required slot must hold a value, and its JSON Schema refuses null; an optional slot may be left out, and its JSON Schema accepts null. The twins require these keys while permitting null values, so the definition marks them optional to retain that nullable shape, and its JSON Schema accepts a document that leaves the key out. value_presence PRESENT makes gen-json-schema put the key in required and still allow null, but the metamodel says PRESENT has "the same effect as required=true" (status unstable) and the Pydantic validation plugin ignores it, so it is not used.
known_looser.why: Present-and-null is a distinction LinkML's data model does not make.

enforced_by: zod/editions.schema.ts: Edition.holiday, Holiday.hebrewName and HistoricalEvent.endDate are optional, not nullable; measured by record compare linkml on the catalog and synthetic fixtures
zod/page.schema.ts: Block.confidence is z.number().optional()
zod/site-common.schema.ts: checked_against is .optional(), not nullable
zod/shared-record.schema.ts: SharedRecord.holders is z.array(...).optional()
pydantic/site_common.py: checked_against refuses null in a field validator (check_is_not_null)
pydantic/shared_record.py: holders has a default and no None; Block.confidence in pydantic/page.py accepts null, so only Zod refuses it
pruzhany-steps: the bundled Zod validator (schemas/site-next/validate-archive.js), before site_writer installs a document
known_looser.export_says: The key may be left out, but when it is there its value may not be null: the key is not in required and its schema has no null branch.
known_looser.linkml_says: gen-json-schema gives every optional slot a null branch (its --include-null, the default). --no-include-null is one switch for a whole schema and would refuse the null that the 248 optional keys which do allow it accept, so the definition keeps the default and its JSON Schema accepts null here. An optional slot with equals_string needs no entry: const refuses null by itself; so does equals_string_in, which the house style uses for a list of values the naming rule refuses or that are addresses (media rights), and whose enum refuses null too.
known_looser.why: Present-and-null is a distinction LinkML's data model does not make.

enforced_by: zod/site-common.schema.ts: pixelBox, a z.tuple of nonnegative, nonnegative, positive, positive
zod/shared-record.schema.ts: Place.coordinates, a z.tuple of min(-90).max(90) and min(-180).max(180)
pydantic/site_common.py: PrintedAddress.bbox, a tuple with ge=0, ge=0, gt=0, gt=0
pydantic/shared_record.py: Place.coordinates, a tuple with ge=-90, le=90 and ge=-180, le=180
pruzhany-steps: the bundled Zod validator (schemas/site-next/validate-archive.js), before site_writer installs a document
known_looser.export_says: Each position of the array has its own bound (prefixItems): a box's x and y are at least 0 and its width and height above 0; a place's latitude lies from -90 to 90 and its longitude from -180 to 180.
known_looser.linkml_says: A multivalued slot has one range and one bound for every item. The definition bounds each of a box's four numbers at least 0 (NonNegativeNumber), so it accepts a width or a height of 0, and each coordinate from -180 to 180, so it accepts a latitude beyond 90. A class with named parts would hold every bound but change the stored shape of a box and of coordinates, which the plan rules out (section 10).
known_looser.why: LinkML has no constraint by position within a list, which is what JSON Schema's prefixItems is.

enforced_by: zod/media.schema.ts: Media.duration is z.number().positive().nullish()
pydantic/media.py: Media.duration is Field(gt=0) or None
pruzhany-steps: the bundled Zod validator (schemas/site-next/validate-archive.js), before site_writer installs a document
known_looser.export_says: A medium's duration is a number above 0 (exclusiveMinimum 0).
known_looser.linkml_says: minimum_value is inclusive and metamodel 1.12.0 has no exclusive bound, so the definition says at least 0 and accepts a duration of 0. none_of with equals_number 0 does refuse 0 in the generated JSON Schema (minimum 0 and not const 0), but the generator then drops the null branch the export allows on this optional key (measured), so it is not used. A whole number above 0 needs no entry: minimum_value 1 says the same (PositiveInteger).
